value.rationale: PAV and approval CC are canonical approval-based committee objectives with a clear substantive tension: repeated representation under harmonic diminishing returns versus maximizing the number of represented voters. The smallest electorate where they make different unambiguous choices is a natural structural invariant, and the forced one-orbit boundary explains the exact mechanism rather than supplying an arbitrary counterexample.
